title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — 'Til Death Do Us Part
Holman houses over 170 men who have been sentenced to death and are awaiting execution, as well as 360 who are serving life sentences without parole; all are living with the inevitable: that their only chance of getting out will be inside a coffin.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Getting Schooled
One inmate learns addiction and motherhood do not make a good mix; two other inmates are left wondering which of them is the father of her child; when a feud from the streets boils over in the jail, deputies are forced to respond.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E2 — It Burns
The Cuyahoga County Correction Center resides in the heart of Cleveland's downtown; a tip leads to an escape plot; a shank turns up in the kitchen; a younger inmate takes a swing at an officer.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E3 — Wombmates
An inmate with a reputation for trouble goes up against a no-nonsense warden; a 71-year-old woman faces conviction for an investment scheme that left nearly 800 victims in its wake; segregating identical twins.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Tempt Not a Desperate Man
The survivor of a vicious attack shares his story in the hopes that other inmates will never commit such violence; for another inmate, it's too late to turn back the clock and now the pain of incarceration has begun to take a toll.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Suicide Watch
An agitated inmate takes severe measures to get staff's attention; a young first-timer is found unconscious in his cell; another inmate garners "enemy status" within the jail.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Unholy Trinity
Every year, close to 70,000 people are processed through the five facilities that make up the Orange County Jail in Southern California; some will call the jail home until their cases are resolved in court - a process that can take years.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Crip and the Cougar
A gang member with a violent past and a long disciplinary record in jail tries to convince staff he's changed; another inmate, once a victim of prison rape, lobbies to do his time in isolation.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — The Shakedown
Correctional officers are outnumbered 10 to 1 and are constantly searching over 1,000 inmates to find their home-made weapons, which are very easy to conceal; hours after the Lock-Up crew wraps shooting, an inmate is stabbed in the honor dorm.

description:

Holman houses over 170 men who have been sentenced to death and are awaiting execution, as well as 360 who are serving life sentences without parole; all are living with the inevitable: that their only chance of getting out will be inside a coffin.

description:

One inmate learns addiction and motherhood do not make a good mix; two other inmates are left wondering which of them is the father of her child; when a feud from the streets boils over in the jail, deputies are forced to respond.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Thicker Than a Bowl of Oatmeal
A gang leader has his authority challenged by another inmate, but questions arise over whether the challenger is who he says he is; in the women's wing, one inmate's personality divides her housing unit; before long, verbal altercations turn violent.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Highs and Lows
The Emergency Response Team have their hands full of a sadistic murderer who transforms the jail, a roller derby queen who takes a hard fall and one inmate who realizes that even a good day in jail can have a dark side.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Time Never Waits
The Emergency Response Team is deployed when a mentally ill inmate soils his cell and refuses orders; a vicious assault sends another inmate to the hospital; a fresh face joins the female unit, and finds herself in the middle of an investigation.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Solitary
A new inmate struggles with life on the tough side of the jail; another inmate is offered a chance to improve his condition but mounts a defense anyway; a female inmate requires some special attention from staff members.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Old School, New School
Gang violence breaks out when a long-simmering feud boils over; caught in the middle of the conflict is a young inmate, and jail staff responds with an all-out search for weapons.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Red and Whites
A group of prisoners are entrusted with potential weapons, but for the benefit of others; one of them hopes this assignment will result in a life-long bond; back at the jail, an inmate brawl leaves several officers injured.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Outlaws and In-Laws
Five miles from the riverfront hotels and restaurants of Savannah, Georgia, is a more ominous site, a place where an inmate is severely injured, and a friendship is torn; two soon to be brothers-in-law are accused of double homicide.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wis-Dumb
A planned romantic weekend turns into a nightmare for one young couple; a fight sends two women to segregation, and for one of the combatants, the isolation takes its toll.
